about: AgentCake site middleware for PHP (cake_edge.php, and the WordPress plugin that carries it): every value it uses. A site may override the values under "options" when it mounts the middleware (camelCase option names, see README.md). The values under "fixed" and "headers" are the Node middleware's (edge/node/defaults.json, edge/node/headers.json), shared with cake's verifier and the shared test vectors (tests/vectors/edge_token.json), so no option changes them; edge/php/tests checks that every value here is the Node middleware's.

sources.skip_extensions: The list of static-file extensions follows @knownagents/sdk 3.1.0 src/paths.ts (Apache-2.0); the rule only, no code.

messages.short_secret: [agentcake] the server middleware secret is shorter than {min} bytes: no token is sent
messages.invalid_options: [agentcake] options with a value of the wrong kind, defaults kept: {names}
messages.client_ip_failed: [agentcake] clientIp threw {error}: tokens go without a network key
messages.token_failed: [agentcake] a page's token could not be made ({error}): the page goes out without it
messages.head_failed: [agentcake] a response head could not be read ({error}): the page goes out without its token
messages.headers_sent: [agentcake] the response head was already sent: call sendHeader() before any output, or no token is sent
